messages.subject: Meaning of error?
parts:
Using v4 of simmer, I'm getting a repeated error on run:

Error: 'Patient0' at 0.41 in 'Branch':
 Expecting a single value: [extent=2].

I'm assuming this is narrowing the error down to the first branch in my simulation, but not sure what it means?

Running plot on the whole trajectory gives the attached diagram.

Thanks,

Ian

messages.author: fa34d387a6db600d
messages.subject: Re: Meaning of error?
parts:
The code for the branch is:

                  branch(function() sample(c(1, 2), prob = c(pca, 1 - pca)),
                         continue = c(TRUE, TRUE),
                  ConsAssess <- trajectory("Consultant Assessment") %>%
                  simmer::select(c("Consultant1", "Consultant2"), policy = "round-robin") %>%
                  seize_selected() %>%
                  timeout(function() rnorm(1, 1/aad, 0.05)) %>%
                  release_selected(),
                  Bypass <- trajectory("Bypass Consultant")) %>%
                  visit("Administrator", function() rnorm(0.034, 0.01)) %>%

It then pipes into a further branch.

Thanks,

Ian

El mié., 25 jul. 2018 a las 11:48, Ian Bowns (<ianb...@gmail.com>) escribió:
>
> Using v4 of simmer, I'm getting a repeated error on run:
>
> Error: 'Patient0' at 0.41 in 'Branch':
> Expecting a single value: [extent=2].

Expecting one value, two were provided (extent=2) by your "option"
function. Particularly, sample(c(1, 2)) returns the whole vector
unless a size is specified.
